title: 8 Day Kenya Fly-in Safari
rank_math_title: Kenya Fly-in Safari: 8 Amazing Days in Three Parks
rank_math_desc: Kenya fly-in safari for 8 days: Samburu, the Masai Mara and Amboseli, linked by light-aircraft flights, with full-board lodges. Price on request.
post_content: This Kenya fly-in safari visits Samburu, the Masai Mara and Amboseli in eight days, with flights between every park.
overview:
This Kenya fly-in safari is the complete Kenyan safari without the long drives. In eight days you visit the dry north at Samburu, the plains of the Masai Mara and the elephants of Amboseli below Kilimanjaro.

Light aircraft link each park, so you spend your days on game drives rather than in a vehicle on the road.

Why choose this Kenya fly-in safari?

  • Samburu: rare northern species and riverside elephants.
  • Masai Mara: three nights for big cats and, in season, the migration.
  • Amboseli: elephants with Kilimanjaro behind them.
  • Comfort: full-board lodges and short scenic flights.

Where you stay

Ashnil Samburu Camp, Mara Serena Safari Lodge and Ol Tukai Lodge, or similar.

Best time for a Kenya fly-in safari

June to October is dry and excellent for wildlife, with the migration in the Mara from July. January to March is also very good, with fewer visitors and green landscapes.

faq.q: How many flights are on the Kenya fly-in safari?
faq.a: Usually four: Nairobi to Samburu, Samburu to the Mara, the Mara to Amboseli via Nairobi, and Amboseli back to Nairobi.

faq.q: How much luggage can I bring?
faq.a: Light aircraft usually allow 15 kg per person, including hand luggage, in soft bags without wheels. Ask us if you need extra space.
Ashnil Samburu Camp, Mara Serena Safari Lodge and Ol Tukai Lodge, or similar.

faq.q: Can I end at the beach?
faq.a: Yes. You can fly from Amboseli or Nairobi to Diani, Watamu or Zanzibar.
Yes. Short flights are easier for children than long road transfers.

faq.q: What is the best time to go?

itinerary.label: Day 1
itinerary.title: Fly from Nairobi to Samburu
itinerary.content: Morning flight from Wilson Airport to Samburu. Game drive to Ashnil Samburu Camp and an afternoon drive.

itinerary.label: Day 2
itinerary.title: Samburu National Reserve
itinerary.content: Morning and afternoon game drives along the Ewaso Ng'iro River.

itinerary.label: Day 3
itinerary.title: Fly from Samburu to the Masai Mara
itinerary.content: Early game drive, then fly to the Mara. Afternoon game drive and check-in at Mara Serena Safari Lodge.

itinerary.label: Day 4
itinerary.title: Masai Mara
itinerary.content: A full day of game drives with a picnic lunch.

itinerary.label: Day 5
itinerary.title: Masai Mara
itinerary.content: Another full day in the reserve, with an optional balloon flight at sunrise.

itinerary.label: Day 6
itinerary.title: Fly from the Masai Mara to Amboseli
itinerary.content: Morning game drive, then fly to Amboseli via Wilson Airport. Afternoon game drive and check-in at Ol Tukai Lodge.

itinerary.label: Day 7
itinerary.title: Amboseli National Park
itinerary.content: Sunrise drive for Kilimanjaro views and elephant herds, with a second drive later in the day.

itinerary.label: Day 8
itinerary.title: Fly back to Nairobi
itinerary.content: Early game drive and a flight back to Wilson Airport.
